scope.summary: Implement a live preflight engine that continuously validates the active document against a selected profile, reporting an error count and per-error fix information, limitable to a page range, with a status indicator (clear/warning/error); preflight MUST also be runnable on export. Implement preflight profiles as editable rule sets carrying severity thresholds: creatable, exportable/importable as portable profile files, and embeddable in a document so recipients preflight against the same rules. Built on the StudioValidationDescriptor catalog (MT-005). Rule categories authored in MT-183.
acceptance_criteria: live preflight with count/status/page-range + run-on-export; editable/portable/embeddable profiles
proof_targets: live-preflight status runtime; profile portability + embed test
expected_tests: live: live preflight reports error count + status indicator, updates as document changes, limitable to page range
test: profile create/export/import portable file + embed in document; run-on-export

risk_if_missed: No output-readiness validation; print/PDF errors reach the press undetected.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
